scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof covers all finite nonempty length sets for positive formulas and all length cutoffs for Boolean formulas. Finite replay corroborates but does not replace infinite proof. Literature risk remains for unlocated exact modal-depth variants.
scientific_limitations: Finite permutation Kripke frames with immediate-successor modality only; Boolean sharp formula restricted to consecutive cycle-length sets; optimizes depth, not formula size.
title: Sharp forward-depth costs of eliminating one-step past on bounded cycles
